candidates.title: A Servant at the Rashōmon Gate
candidates.rights_status_quote: 「著作権の切れている作品」については、「了解を求めたりする必要はありません。」
candidates.rights_reasoning: Aozora Bunko explicitly states that works whose copyright has expired require no permission; its work card identifies Ryūnosuke Akutagawa as having died in 1927, and the specific Aozora card is marked as a publicly available work. ([aozora.gr.jp](https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000879/card127.html))
candidates.story_fit_reason: A starving servant must decide what to do beneath a ruined gate after finding a woman stealing hair from a corpse, giving the adaptation one immediate conflict and a clear moral choice.
candidates.concern: The legacy card page does not expose the individual rights badge in the captured text; confirm the current per-work metadata before publication.

candidates.title: The Friend Who Must Run
candidates.rights_status_quote: 青空文庫では各作品やその図書カードには簡易的に「著作権あり」「著作権なし」の表示がなされています
candidates.rights_reasoning: Aozora says that its works and book cards carry an explicit copyright-status indication, and the specific card identifies Osamu Dazai’s death as June 13, 1948; the work is therefore a strong public-domain candidate under Aozora’s no-copyright category. ([aozora.gr.jp](https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000035/card1567.html))
candidates.story_fit_reason: A man must reach a place in time to save his friend while overcoming exhaustion, making the plot easy to retell through simple actions, deadlines, and dialogue.
candidates.concern: Because Dazai died in 1948, the rights determination should be checked against the current card metadata rather than inferred from the death date alone.

candidates.title: Two Hunters at the Strange Restaurant
candidates.rights_status_quote: 「著作権の切れている作品」については、「了解を求めたりする必要はありません。」
candidates.rights_reasoning: Aozora’s own policy says no permission is needed for works with expired copyright; the Aozora card records Kenji Miyazawa’s death in 1933 and identifies this as a self-contained short story. ([aozora.gr.jp](https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000081/card1927.html))
candidates.story_fit_reason: Two hungry hunters follow a sequence of increasingly alarming instructions in an isolated restaurant, creating a compact survival story with repetitive, learner-friendly escalation.
candidates.concern: The card’s captured text does not display the individual ‘著作権なし’ label, so the current rights field should be rechecked.

candidates.title: A Night Encounter in a Narrow Street
candidates.rights_status_quote: 青空文庫では各作品やその図書カードには簡易的に「著作権あり」「著作権なし」の表示がなされています
candidates.rights_reasoning: Aozora states that each work or book card has a copyright-status label; its card identifies Motojirō Kajii as having died in 1932, making this a plausible no-copyright candidate subject to confirming the card’s current status label. ([aozora.gr.jp](https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000074/card423.html))
candidates.story_fit_reason: The piece focuses on a sharply observed nighttime scene involving two animals, which could be abstracted into a very short descriptive story about an unexpected encounter.
candidates.concern: This is more atmospheric than event-driven, and the individual rights label was not visible in the accessible legacy card text.
